content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in the early part of the 30-day forecast, especially for the first 5–10 days.
- Overestimates prices after sharp spikes in the history (e.g., after 70+ values), often overshooting by 2–5%.
- Tends to ignore mean reversion in the middle of the forecast horizon, leading to persistent underestimation of upward trends.
- Shows lag in reacting to recent high values — true outcomes often rise faster than model predicts.
- Underestimates the final 5–7 days of the forecast, particularly when true values show strong upward momentum.
- Overly conservative in the first 3–5 days, failing to capture early momentum or volatility spikes.
- Sensitive to recent low values — model often holds onto low forecasts even when history shows rebound potential.
- Fails to adjust for seasonal or event-driven price surges (e.g., July 2024) — tends to underestimate spikes in late forecast period.
